assets.caption: EXHIBIT 3-15 Typical Access Requirements in a Vertical Arrangement
assets.description: Sectional view of a multi-level industrial structure showing equipment arranged vertically. Annotations indicate 'EXCHANGER TUBE BUNDLE PULLING AREA' at the top level, 'MIXER REMOVAL AREA' at a middle level, 'MAINTENANCE & OPERATION ACCESS WAYS' on the left side, and 'AUXILIARY ROAD' at ground level on the right.
